evidence.quote: I think I'd like to start tracking my expenses. Can you recommend any good budgeting apps? I've been using my credit card a lot lately, and I'm pretty sure I spent a lot on luxury items last month. I remember buying a designer handbag for a pretty penny - $800, to be exact.

I think it's a good idea to set some boundaries. I've been doing some research and found that there are some affordable alternatives to high-end brands that offer similar quality at a lower price point. I've started browsing online at stores like H&M and Uniqlo, and was surprised at how many stylish pieces I could find. I'm also considering canceling my subscription to a monthly beauty box, which was costing me $50 a month. While it was fun to receive a new package every month, I realized that I wasn't using most of the products and was just accumulating a bunch of samples. Instead, I've started buying beauty products at a discount store, where I can find similar products at a fraction of the cost.
